preconditions.description: The input integers n and m are within the range [1, 1000000].
The parsed input values n and m are integers.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for x in range(1, n + 1) for y in range(1, m + 1) if (x + y) % 5 == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of pairs (x, y) where 1 <= x <= n, 1 <= y <= m, and (x + y) is divisible by 5.
